title: Slang
body:
# Slang

Slang adds the main puzzle feature from [Lingo](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1814170/Lingo/) and [Lingo 2](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2523310/Lingo_2/).
With it you can create puzzles in your survival world or for adventure maps, to bring the world of creative wordplay to Minecraft!

For hints:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

You can press the DEL key to reveal the first letter of any answer

</details>
